notes:
1. Wells Fargo section says "Faraz Shafiq, the bank's head of AI products and solutions, says redesigning workflows with AI in mind is "the biggest area of focus" in 2027." Source (Banking Dive feed): "In 2027, redesigning workflows with AI in mind is "the biggest area of focus" for Faraz Shafiq, the bank's head of AI products and solutions." The outlet says it, not Shafiq, and it is his area of focus, not stated as Wells Fargo's. Fix: "For Faraz Shafiq, the bank's head of AI products and solutions, redesigning workflows with AI in mind is "the biggest area of focus" in 2027, Banking Dive reports." Also the heading "Wells Fargo points at workflows" should not credit the bank: e.g. "A Wells Fargo AI lead on workflows".
2. Brief 2026-10-21-wells-fargo-ai-workflow-focus: headline "Wells Fargo says redesigning workflows with AI is its biggest area of focus" and body "Faraz Shafiq ... says redesigning workflows ... is "the biggest area of focus"". Source: "is "the biggest area of focus" for Faraz Shafiq". Fix: headline "Wells Fargo AI head's biggest area of focus in 2027 is redesigning workflows"; body "In 2027, redesigning workflows with AI in mind is "the biggest area of focus" for Faraz Shafiq, Wells Fargo's head of AI products and solutions, Banking Dive reports."
3. Dek says "Starling says its agent investigates fraud in 17 seconds" and the Starling heading says "Starling puts an agent on fraud"; the section says "a fraud or compliance queue". Source: "agentic "financial crime investigator" that the UK digital bank says can carry out an end-to-end investigation within 17 seconds." Fraud is narrower than financial crime, and "within 17 seconds" is not "in 17 seconds". Fix: dek "Starling says its financial crime agent can run an investigation within 17 seconds"; heading "Starling puts an agent on financial crime"; "a financial crime queue".
4. Brief 2026-10-21-starling-agentic-fincrime-investigator headline "can work in 17 seconds". Source: "can carry out an end-to-end investigation within 17 seconds". Fix: "can complete an investigation within 17 seconds".
5. Section 1 says "Three stories from the last day put agents closer to real money and real investigations". Source for the third story (Wells Fargo) is only a stated workflow focus, with no money or investigation. Fix: "Two stories from the last day put agents closer to real money and real investigations, a third points at workflow redesign, and a fourth shows what can go wrong inside the tooling around them." Also drop "Let's walk through them in turn and then put them side by side." since the note never puts them side by side; the Wells section only says "reading the other stories today".
